defs.def: a hard brown sweet food made from cocoa beans, used in cooking to add flavour to cakes, etc. or eaten as a sweet/candy 巧克力；朱古力

ex.s: A couple of years ago, film-maker David Bond realised that his children, then aged five and three, were attached to screens to the point where he was able to say "chocolate" into his three-year-old son’s ear without getting a response.
ex.t: 几年前，电影制作人大卫·邦德意识到，他当时五岁和三岁的孩子对屏幕的依赖已经到了这种程度：他对三岁的儿子耳边说“巧克力”都得不到任何反应。

defs.def: a sweet/candy that is made of or covered with chocolate 巧克力糖；夹心巧克力糖

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: 有了3D打印机，厨师能打印复杂的巧克力雕塑和婚礼蛋糕上漂亮的装饰件。不是人人都能做到——那需要多年经验，但打印机让它变得简单。西班牙一家餐厅用Foodini“重现”食物的“形状和部件”，做到“完全一致”，解放厨师去完成其他任务。另一家餐厅所有菜肴甜点都是3D打印的，而非从农场到餐桌。

ex.s: Too much chocolate isn't good for you.
ex.t: 吃太多巧克力对你不好。

ex.s: So, if you're a sugar addict and aren't able to say no to chocolate or cola, you had better download it now!
ex.t: 所以，如果你是个嗜糖者，无法对巧克力或可乐说不，你最好现在就下载它！

ex.s: EXAMPLE 1 When I set off for the cafeteria … 2 Before he went into the chocolate factory … 3 By the time I arrived at the “insect” party … … I had just finished my homework.
ex.t: 示例1当我出发去自助餐厅时…… 2在他进入巧克力工厂之前…… 3当我到达“昆虫”派对时……我刚刚完成作业。

ex.s: Scientists believe that having small amounts of things we would normally classify as harmful might be good for us, such as chocolate, coffee or sunbathing!
ex.t: 科学家认为，少量我们通常会归类为有害的东西可能对我们有好处，例如巧克力、咖啡或日光浴！

ex.s: We went on nature walks, had picnics on beautiful beaches and drank hot chocolate underthestars.
ex.t: 我们在大自然中散步，在美丽的海滩上野餐，喝热巧克力。

ex.s: In the cafe, the couple bought Emily a hot chocolate and listened patiently as she explained her desperate situation: she was about a hundred miles from her destination, her car was completely stuck, and her entire holiday plan could be ruined.
ex.t: 在咖啡馆里，这对夫妇给Emily买了一杯热巧克力，耐心地听她讲述自己的困境：她离目的地还有约一百英里，车彻底陷住了，整个假期计划都可能泡汤。

defs.def: a dark brown colour 深褐色；巧克力色
